## How to read the catalogue

This page summarises all **45** records in the machine-readable catalogue. The core scope is ==type 1 diabetes (T1D)== education and self-management; adjacent categories are retained because they expose useful mechanisms, outcomes or sustainability problems. Inclusion is not endorsement.

Evidence and access are independent fields. “Public product without peer-reviewed evaluation” means that a product could be located but that no qualifying outcome study was identified. “Unavailable” means that no public build was located at the stated verification date; it does not prove that no private or institutional copy exists. Unless a later date is shown, access was verified on **24 August 2026**. No product was playtested during this desk-research phase.

The [canonical JSON record](../../data/games.json) retains aliases, release history, intended roles, language, learning objectives, core loop, mechanisms, detailed study extraction, developer classification, lived-experience involvement, price, monetisation, region, account and hardware requirements, source links, image provenance, design assessment and confidence.

## Data-quality rules

1. A product has one stable identifier even when its title or platform changes.
2. Developer claims are recorded as provenance or marketing, never as measured effects.
3. Unknown values remain “unknown” or “not verified”; they are not inferred from branding.
4. Access status includes a verification date and confidence level.
5. Research access, study-only access and public access are different states.
6. Screenshot metadata can point to an external source or a private-review copy. Third-party images are not automatically licensed for public republication.
7. Every record remains `not_playtested` until direct, documented assessment occurs.
